caseNameFull: Payton v. New York and Riddick v. New York

opinions.text: Appeals from Ct. App. N. Y. Motions of appellants for leave to proceed in *1045forma pauperis granted. In No. 78-5420, probable jurisdiction is noted limited to Question 1 presented by the jurisdictional statement. In No. 78-5421, probable jurisdiction noted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 45 N. Y. 2d 300, 380 N. E. 2d 224.
